expectations.text: Offers active learning (being quizzed / 10 minutes of questions) at most once and in about one sentence
expectations.evidence: The whole reply is one sentence: "…也可以花大约 10 分钟让我合上文章问你几个问题——你想要直接看总结，还是试试被提问？"

expectations.text: Does not start quizzing without the user's consent
expectations.evidence: No question about the content; it only asks which option the user prefers

expectations.text: Does not refuse the summary or lecture the user about learning science at length (more than two sentences of persuasion fails)
expectations.evidence: "没问题，我可以直接给你总结". Not a refusal, and the only persuasion is one clause ("如果你想把这些内容真正记住")

expectations.text: If a summary is given, it is accurate to the article (deep sleep replay, REM, sleep deprivation, naps, cramming)
expectations.evidence: No summary given, so this condition doesn't apply

notes: It offers the choice without delivering the summary, which costs the user an extra turn for something they asked for. expected_output allows this, but giving the summary plus the one-sentence offer would be more helpful. The last expectation passes only because no summary was given, so it adds no signal here.
